hypotheses.title: Gold Consultant Production: Four Non-Templated Orthogonal Alphas Targeting EXCELLENT and SPECTACULAR Status
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Engineered strictly for the Gold Level Consultant Track to achieve minimum 'GOOD' (Fitness >= 1.50) and priority 'EXCELLENT' / 'SPECTACULAR' (Fitness >= 1.80, Sharpe >= 2.10) ratings with zero formula template recycling: (1) LEAP Call-Put Skew Imbalance (option8): 2-year call IV expanding relative to put IV reflects institutional upside convexity accumulation over tail hedging. (2) Funds From Operations Realized Cash Yield in TOP1000 (fnd6_fopo): Operational cash flow yield evaluated over a 170-day window generates high returns with ultra-low turnover (~8%), maximizing the Fitness multiplier. (3) Analyst Consensus Price Target Upside (analyst4): 60-day smoothed consensus target upside identifies sell-side rerating drift ahead of institutional block trades. (4) 2-Year LEAP Call Options Demand Percentile (option8): 90-day time-series rank of 2-year call IV over 120-day Parkinson volatility captures institutional volatility mispricing with low turnover.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if consensus price targets prove uninformative or if options call skew reflects retail gambling rather than informed institutional positioning.
